claude.performance_metric: FY2016 net earnings $15M attributable (1% of revenue), returning to profit after $(80)M in 2015 and $(123)M in 2014; revenues declined $2,046M (2014) to $1,543M (2016); no goodwill impairment
claude.rationale: The slice documents the divested PI/DI product businesses missing their first post-sale adjusted-EBITDA target (triggering a $4M purchase-price repayment in 2016), which signals possible post-deal product/operations underperformance but does not attribute it to an inability to align the product with operating processes — hence p4 is uncertain rather than 1. No line describes any operations-versus-people/management/culture fracture over the window (the record instead shows continued public reporting, a return to positive net earnings, staged completion of divestitures, and no goodwill impairment), so p5 is coded 0 for none documented. The slice contains no information on controlling-intent archetype or business-model reconciliation, so t1 and t2 are uncertain.

gemini.performance_metric: FY2016 net earnings attributable to Eastman Kodak Company were $15 million
gemini.rationale: The slice documents the post-deal trajectory of Eastman Kodak, noting a return to positive net earnings by FY2016 and the completion of deferred closings for the PI/DI businesses. There is no documented evidence of disruption at the product/process interface (p4_pathway) or fracture at the process/organization interface (p5_pathway) over the 3-5 year horizon.

grok.performance_metric: FY2016 net earnings $15M after prior losses; PI/DI transfer done with $4M repayment
grok.rationale: The slice documents only the staged completion of the PI/DI divestiture by September 2015 and a $4M earnout repayment after the buyer-side business missed its 2015 adjusted-EBITDA target; it does not record any realized inability to align an acquired product line with operating processes, so p4_pathway is 0. No evidence is given of operations fracturing against people, management, or culture over the window, so p5_pathway is likewise 0.
